title: The Scorching Mod
description: This project adds a new dimension, damage type, and new mobs (including one undead boss) and 3 new structures! This mod is something I made for fun some years ago, and I'm deciding to upload it to modrinth now but I might be missing some features.
body:
Hello! Thanks for checking out my mod!
The Scorching Mod is the first ever mod I've ever released, and it's made with MCreator. I found it very fun so I decided to share it on Modrinth!

#### PLEASE NOTE: FOR THE FORGE 1.20.1 VERSION OF THE MOD, THE PORTAL IS BROKEN. THIS TEXT WILL BE REMOVED WHEN I FIX IT. FOR NOW, USE THE NEOFORGE VERSION OF THE MOD FOR THE FULL EXPERIENCE

**Mod Contents:**

1 brand new dimension

3 different structures

1 new boss (along with a new track that plays)

A few new items, such as Infernium, which is obtained by mining Infernium Ore, a new sword called the Splinter, which lets you dash by right-clicking and attacking while dashing sets enemies on fire.

A new useful block called the "Special Dispenser" (very creative I know) which can be right clicked on and you can place blocks in it and it will extrude those blocks upon being powered by redstone (the length depends on the amount you put and the extrusion direction is dependant on the block's direction.) Please note that this block can break sand when extruding

I'm probably forgetting some things since I made this mod like a year ago and I haven't really touched the project for a long time

Don't expect everything to be completely bugless and polished as this is my first time publishing a mod. Hope you enjoy my mod!

Also the boss might need to get nerfed majorly
